# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for chained `dig` calls that can be collapsed into a single `dig`.
      #
      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it cannot be guaranteed that the receiver
      #   is an `Enumerable` or does not have a nonstandard implementation
      #   of `dig`.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      #
      #   # good - `dig`s cannot be combined
      #   x.dig(:foo).bar.dig(:baz)
      #
      class DigChain < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include RangeHelp
        include CommentsHelp
        include DigHelp

        MSG = 'Use `%<replacement>s` instead of chaining.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[dig].freeze

        def on_send(node)
          harvest_dig_chain_context(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          range, arguments = inspect_chain(node)
          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        private

        # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
        def inspect_chain(node)
          arguments = node.arguments.dup
          end_pos = node.source_range.end_pos

          while dig?((node = node.receiver))
            begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1 : 0
            arguments.unshift(*node.arguments)
            ignore_node(node)
          end

          return unless begin_pos

          [range_between(begin_pos, end_pos), arguments]
        end

        def invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          # If any of the arguments are arguments forwarding (`...`), it can only be the
          # first argument, or else the resulting code will have a syntax error.

          return false unless arguments&.any?

          forwarded_args_index = arguments.index(&:forwarded_args_type?)
          forwarded_args_index && forwarded_args_index < (arguments.size - 1)
        end

        def register_offense(node, range, arguments)
          remember_collapsed_chain(range, arguments)
          arguments = arguments.map(&:source).join(', ')
          replacement = "dig(#{arguments})"

          add_offense(range, message: format(MSG, replacement: replacement)) do |corrector|
            corrector.replace(range, replacement)

            comments_in_range(node).reverse_each do |comment|
              corrector.insert_before(node, "#{comment.source}\n")
            end
          end
        end
        DIG_CALL_PATTERN = RuboCop::AST::NodePattern.new(
          '(call _ :dig !{hash block_pass}+)'
        )
        SINGLE_ARGUMENT_DIG_PATTERN = RuboCop::AST::NodePattern.new(
          '(send _ :dig $!splat)'
        )

        def self.dig_node?(node)
          DIG_CALL_PATTERN.match(node)
        end

        def self.single_argument_dig_node(node)
          SINGLE_ARGUMENT_DIG_PATTERN.match(node)
        end

        def self.dig_chain_cop_enabled?(cop)
          cop.config.for_cop('Style/DigChain')['Enabled']
        end

        def self.compose_source_range(cop, start_pos, end_pos)
          Parser::Source::Range.new(cop.processed_source.buffer, start_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def self.compose_range_with_surrounding_space(cop, range, side, newlines, whitespace,
                                                      continuations, buffer)
          src = buffer.source
          go_left, go_right = surround_directions(side)
          begin_pos = range.begin_pos
          if go_left
            begin_pos = surround_final_pos(src, begin_pos, -1, continuations, newlines, whitespace)
          end
          end_pos = range.end_pos
          if go_right
            end_pos = surround_final_pos(src, end_pos, 1, continuations, newlines, whitespace)
          end
          Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def self.surround_directions(side)
          if side == :both
            [true, true]
          else
            [side == :left, side == :right]
          end
        end

        def self.surround_final_pos(src, pos, increment, continuations, newlines, whitespace)
          pos = surround_move_pos(src, pos, increment, true, /[ \t]/)
          pos = surround_move_pos_str(src, pos, increment, continuations, "\\\n")
          pos = surround_move_pos(src, pos, increment, newlines, /\n/)
          surround_move_pos(src, pos, increment, whitespace, /\s/)
        end

        def self.surround_move_pos(src, pos, step, condition, regexp)
          offset = step == -1 ? -1 : 0
          pos += step while condition && regexp.match?(src[pos + offset])
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def self.surround_move_pos_str(src, pos, step, condition, needle)
          size = needle.length
          offset = step == -1 ? -size : 0
          pos += size * step while condition && src[pos + offset, size] == needle
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def self.source_range_with_comment_for(cop, node)
          begin_pos = begin_pos_with_comment_for(cop, node)
          end_pos = end_position_for_node(cop, node)
          Parser::Source::Range.new(cop.processed_source.buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def self.contains_comments_for?(cop, node)
          comments_in_range_for(cop, node).any?
        end

        def self.comments_in_range_for(cop, node)
          start_line = node.source_range.line
          end_line = find_end_line_for(cop, node)
          cop.processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(start_line...end_line)
        end

        def self.comments_contain_disables_for?(cop, node, cop_name)
          disabled_ranges = cop.processed_source.disabled_line_ranges[cop_name]
          return false unless disabled_ranges

          node_range = node.source_range.line...find_end_line_for(cop, node)
          disabled_ranges.any? do |disable_range|
            disable_range.cover?(node_range) || node_range.cover?(disable_range)
          end
        end

        def self.end_position_for_node(cop, node)
          buffer = cop.processed_source.buffer
          end_line = buffer.line_for_position(node.source_range.end_pos)
          buffer.line_range(end_line).end_pos
        end

        def self.begin_pos_with_comment_for(cop, node)
          first_comment = cop.processed_source.ast_with_comments[node].first
          if first_comment && first_comment.loc.line < node.loc.line
            start_line_position_for(cop, first_comment)
          else
            start_line_position_for(cop, node)
          end
        end

        def self.start_line_position_for(cop, node)
          cop.processed_source.buffer.line_range(node.loc.line).begin_pos - 1
        end

        def self.find_end_line_for(_cop, node)
          if node.if_type?
            if node.else?
              node.loc.else.line
            elsif node.ternary?
              node.else_branch.loc.line
            elsif node.elsif?
              node.each_ancestor(:if).find(&:if?).loc.end.line
            end

        x.y.z.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      RUBY

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with multiple values' do

      RUBY

        dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
